name: Outbound
short_description: Design a governed LinkedIn outbound campaign from scratch through Dreamstate: ground the ICP, propose source and table work, build a custom sequence, stage bounded evidence runs, and launch only after explicit approval. Use whenever the user wants cold outreach, a lead list, a new campaign, demos, or pipeline. This orchestrator uses the same revision-bound proposal and durable-run lifecycle as Architect, Claude, and Codex.
requires_human_approval: Before sending, publishing, activating, deleting, or starting a paid bulk run.
